title: Integrating transcriptomic data to identify calmodulin-related diagnostic biomarkers for Alzheimer's disease.
authors: Wang, Xi'An; Huang, Yanbin; Li, Jiuru
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组和机器学习识别阿尔茨海默病钙调蛋白相关诊断标志物，虽涉及转录因子网络但非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且无AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BackgroundAlzheimer's disease (AD) is driven by amyloid-beta, tau protein, and neuroinflammation. Calmodulin-mediated calcium signaling centrally links synaptic dysfunction, tauopathy, and inflammation, making it a key mechanistic and therapeutic target.ObjectiveTo identify calmodulin-related diagnostic biomarkers for AD and explore associated immune profiles and molecular subtypes.MethodsThe present work utilized integrative bioinformatics for the characterization of calmodulin-related genes in AD. Differentially expressed calmodulin-related genes were identified from Gene Expression Omnibus datasets and the Human Protein Atlas. Core genes were screened using weighted gene co-expression network analysis combined with three machine learning algorithms (Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator, random forest, and Support Vector Machine), from which a diagnostic model was subsequently constructed and validated. Immune infiltration was evaluated via ssGSEA and CIBERSORT, transcription factor and ceRNA regulatory networks were established, and small-molecule drugs were predicted. Consensus clustering was further applied to define molecular subtypes.ResultsFrom 50 differentially expressed genes, three core genes-MKNK2, ITPKB, and CEP97-showed strong diagnostic performance. Immune cell alterations were uncovered, regulatory networks and drug candidates predicted, and consensus clustering divided AD patients into two distinct subtypes.ConclusionsITPKB, MKNK2, and CEP97 are identified as calmodulin-related AD biomarkers linked to immune infiltration and subtyping, with potential for early diagnosis and novel therapies.
abstract_zh: 背景阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）由淀粉样蛋白-β、tau蛋白和神经炎症驱动。钙调蛋白介导的钙信号传导在突触功能障碍、tau蛋白病变和炎症之间起核心连接作用，使其成为关键机制和治疗靶点。目的识别与钙调蛋白相关的AD诊断生物标志物，并探索相关的免疫谱和分子亚型。方法本研究利用整合生物信息学方法表征AD中钙调蛋白相关基因。从Gene Expression Omnibus数据集和Human Protein Atlas中鉴定差异表达的钙调蛋白相关基因。通过加权基因共表达网络分析结合三种机器学习算法（最小绝对收缩和选择算子、随机森林和支持向量机）筛选核心基因，随后构建并验证诊断模型。通过ssGSEA和CIBERSORT评估免疫浸润，建立转录因子和ceRNA调控网络，并预测小分子药物。进一步应用共识聚类定义分子亚型。结果从50个差异表达基因中，三个核心基因——MKNK2、ITPKB和CEP97——显示出较强的诊断性能。揭示了免疫细胞变化，预测了调控网络和候选药物，共识聚类将AD患者分为两个不同的亚型。结论ITPKB、MKNK2和CEP97被确定为与免疫浸润和亚型相关的钙调蛋白相关AD生物标志物，具有早期诊断和新疗法开发的潜力。
